description: List a job’s Read Required compliance (job_instructions.compliance.list): the employer compliance matrix the dashboard shows — per participating contract, the worker’s state against the job’s published releases (NO_REVIEW_REQUIRED / SYNCING / ACTION_REQUIRED / MARKED_READ / UNDERSTOOD), the outstanding count and the last read / understood timestamps. Workers are referenced by workerUserId with a masked display name. Employer-only (worker acknowledgments never cross this surface) and gated by the Read Required rollout for the actor: outside it the read is a 404 like the release tools. Keyset pagination: hasMore/nextCursor. Requires instructions:read.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_compliance
